edition_angle: Sensory flexibility and neurodevelopmental genetic risk factors in cortical processing.

assignments.angle: Shank3 deletion disrupts taste valence adaptability and stimulus-evoked cortical suppression during associative learning.
assignments.reason: Offers a concrete cellular and circuit-level neurophysiological mechanism (two-photon calcium imaging of gustatory cortex neurons during conditioned taste aversion learning) linking a specific genetic risk factor to sensory flexibility defects.
